meta.title: Halloran — a book designer, in almost nothing
meta.description: A very minimal site: one quiet sans, white paper, a statement, a ledger of books as ruled rows, three notes on the approach, and a contact form. No pictures, no colour, no style variation. Built from a gogh site definition.
meta.author: jamiemarsland
